name: open-brain-v2

scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev:full: npm run compose:up && concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta 'npm:dev:backend' 'npm:dev:frontend'
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend

comment:overrides: Pin patched versions of transitive CVE deps whose parents (firecrawl-js, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @azure/*, ajv, wait-on) haven't shipped the fix yet. Exact versions (no caret) so npm forces nested/exact pins. All within-major. Drop an entry once its parent upgrades past the advisory. See CI.md.
